tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches the current job listings on Christian Jobs List by keyword, category, remote and location, and returns each job with a link to its page on Christian Jobs List.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns one current Christian Jobs List job by its id, with a sanitized description of up to 8,000 characters and a link to its page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the job categories on Christian Jobs List with how many current listings each one has.
